meta.title: Delete session
meta.description: Adds Delete session and Trash entries to the session context menu. Deleting asks first: the menu item opens a confirmation dialog showing the session title with No and a red Yes, delete, rendered in the frame-wide overlay layer, and a session that is still running is refused. A delete moves the session directory into $DSH_HOME/session-delete-trash/ instead of unlinking it, clears the projection cache, the workspace mount, the pin and the archive reference, and broadcasts the official removed event, so the sidebar updates without a page refresh. Trash opens a panel listing each entry with its session directory, workspace, deletion time and size, where an entry can be restored to its original workspace, purged individually, or the whole trash emptied. Entries older than the retention window (30 days by default, tunable with DSH_SESSION_DELETE_RETENTION_DAYS) are purged permanently when the trash is listed or a delete runs. Every Host route enforces a same-origin check (Origin/Host and Sec-Fetch-Site), so a page on another site cannot call it.
